faqs.question: What is the core business of Astcare?
faqs.answer: We are a professional software development provider focusing on combining advanced AI (Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen) with Geo spatial optimization to deliver high-concurrency, intelligent SaaS platforms.

faqs.question: How do you guarantee the accuracy of AI outputs?
faqs.answer: We utilize advanced RAG pipelines and hybrid LLM routing. The system auto-switches between Grok (real-time info), DeepSeek (logic), and localized models, guarded by strict safety mechanisms.

faqs.question: What is the typical software dev timeline?
faqs.answer: Thanks to our AI-assisted CI/CD platforms, delivery times have been drastically cut. MVPs usually take 2-4 weeks, while complex AI-agent systems take 6-12 weeks.

faqs.question: What is Geo Optimization?
faqs.answer: It is extreme bottom-layer acceleration for geospatial data storage and querying. It radically lowers the latency of regional data dashboards, LBS, and routing services by up to 80%.

faqs.question: Is our business data safe with you?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We employ zero-trust architectures and isolated VPCs. For sensitive data, we deploy models like Qwen completely privately within your own infrastructure.
